grad_x_centered_2nd_uniform_cartesian_2d.doc: Centered 2nd-order x-derivative grad(u,x) = (u[i+1,j] - u[i-1,j]) / (2 dx) on a 2-D uniform Cartesian grid (loop indices i over x, j over y; uniform spacing dx). The 2-D counterpart of centered_2nd_uniform.json: it holds the non-differentiated axis j fixed and offsets only the x index i, so the replacement is a scalar per-cell expression in the discretizer's spatial loops (i,j) rather than a 1-D arrayop. Use for a level-set Hamilton-Jacobi front where the gradient feeds an already-per-cell right-hand side (psi_t = -S|grad psi|^2); the Godunov upwind form (godunov_norm_1st_uniform_cartesian_2d) is preferred for stability but needs an array intermediate. The grad reads u[i+-1,j] at the boundary are handled by the consumer's ghost-cell lowering. The spacing token 'dx' is the model's grid-spacing parameter; a consumer may rename it to a namespaced parameter (e.g. LevelSetFireSpread.dx) when loading.

grad_y_centered_2nd_uniform_cartesian_2d.doc: Centered 2nd-order y-derivative grad(u,y) = (u[i,j+1] - u[i,j-1]) / (2 dx) on a 2-D uniform Cartesian grid (loop indices i over x, j over y; uniform spacing dx). Companion to grad_x_centered_2nd_uniform_cartesian_2d: holds the non-differentiated axis i fixed and offsets only the y index j. Same usage notes and 'dx' spacing-token convention.
